Each course can have multiple students enrolled, and each course is taught by one instructor. Additionally, students can take multiple courses. questions.text: Consider a relation R(CustomerID, Name, Address, OrderID, Product, Quantity) with the following set of functional dependencies F over R: F={CustomerID->Name, OrderID->Product, Product->Quantity}. Analyze the relational schema for normalization.

questions.text: A university department maintains a database to manage its courses and enrollments. The relation Course(course_id: string, course_name: string, credits: integer, department: string) contains details of all courses offered. The relation Enrollment(student_id: string, course_id: string, semester: string) records which students are enrolled in which courses during a particular semester. Based on this schema, answer the following questions.
